subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is source-verifiable, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current main docs frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen canonical default surface with schema, help/docs, tests, and explicit CLI override precedence.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave `--deliver` as an intentional per-session flag and close or document the ergonomics request after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Change the default instead
options.body: Make delivery on by default with an opt-out only if maintainers accept the compatibility and message-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve a persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen canonical default surface with schema, help/docs, tests, and explicit CLI override precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI surface and most adjacent history trace to `steipete`, and the remaining question is a TUI/default product contract.
